title: Content containment
evidence: Rendered document and element bounds at supported widths; inspect intended scroll regions
completion: Required content is reachable without unintended clipping, overlap or horizontal page scroll

title: Readable contrast
evidence: Rendered composite foreground/background measurements; explicitly mark unsupported image/transparent cases
completion: Applicable contrast thresholds hold for each tested state and theme

title: Equivalent comparison rows
applicability: Adjacent cards presenting equivalent categories or actions
evidence: Pairwise top/bottom bounds for named categories, status, approval and action rows with long and missing content
completion: Equivalent rows share tracks within the declared tolerance; stacked mobile cards remain readable

title: Spacing and gutters
evidence: Unslop spacing/gutter findings plus rendered token values and deliberate exceptions
completion: Grouping and gutters follow the actual product scale without collisions

title: Control geometry
evidence: Unslop row/target measurements including effective hit regions and joined-control exceptions
completion: Controls have adequate hit areas, separation and consistent geometry for their role

title: Keyboard and focus
evidence: Actual tab, activate, escape and focus-return interaction assertions
completion: Primary task works by keyboard, focus is visible and no unintended trap remains

title: Names and semantics
evidence: Accessibility tree, labels, error associations and available a11y checks
completion: Tested controls expose correct names, roles, values and associated feedback

title: Loading feedback
evidence: Delayed-response interaction capture with pending and completion assertions
completion: Pending state is perceivable and cannot cause accidental duplicate submission

title: Error recovery
evidence: Injected failure, retained input, message and successful retry assertions
completion: Failure explains a useful recovery path and retry preserves required data

title: Empty and missing data
evidence: Empty collection and absent-field captures and resulting state assertions
completion: Missing data is explicit, layout remains usable and the next action is available

title: Zoom and motion preferences
evidence: Zoom/reflow and reduced-motion checks; use existing motion tooling for authored motion journeys
completion: Content remains usable at supported zoom and motion preferences are respected

title: Generic template tells
applicability: Every marketing or product surface built or restyled by an agent
evidence: impeccable-probe.js measurement artifact (pinned impeccable detect) for the case route or source directory; tells it cannot see, such as bounce easing it missed, need their own check
completion: The pinned detector reports zero slop-category findings, or each remaining finding is a recorded deliberate brand choice

title: Visual hierarchy
evidence: Annotated screenshot tied to audience and primary task, rationale and competing interpretation
completion: Reviewer explains what draws attention first and why that supports the task

title: Typography
evidence: Real long text at mobile and desktop; type tokens and hierarchy rationale
completion: Reading order, line length and type hierarchy suit the audience and brand

title: Information density
evidence: Realistic populated view with novice/expert task context
completion: Reviewer explains whether information and whitespace support decisions without hiding needed detail

title: Composition and rhythm
evidence: Full rendered composition and section relationships
completion: Grouping, balance and rhythm support meaning; novelty is not required

title: Useful imagery
applicability: Images or a deliberate absence of imagery
evidence: Rendered crops and explanation of what each image contributes
completion: Imagery conveys useful context without obscuring content or imitating an unrelated identity

title: Clear, specific copy
applicability: Instructions, labels and calls to action
evidence: Actual copy in task context, with ambiguous or unsupported claims identified
completion: People can understand the next action and its consequence without generic promotional filler

title: Brand consistency
evidence: Documented product tokens, approved references and screenshot comparison; absent approvals stay explicit
completion: Choices follow this product's documented identity; inferred rationale and unapproved references are labeled

title: Main-task clarity
evidence: Screenshot with explanation of primary versus secondary actions for the named audience
completion: Reviewer can explain the intended task and how its affordances communicate it

title: Complete the real task
evidence: Interaction steps and independent expected/observed resulting state, including reload when applicable
completion: Representative user completes the defined task and receives the correct persisted result

title: Realistic long content
applicability: User text, names, labels and localization
evidence: Operate the workflow with long realistic values, wrapped labels and long unbroken values
completion: Required information and actions remain available and submitted values are preserved

title: Incomplete input/data
applicability: Optional fields and partially populated records
evidence: Operate with absent optional fields and incomplete required fields
completion: Optional omissions work and required omissions yield actionable errors without losing input

title: Failure and retry journey
evidence: Fail then retry the actual action; assert state, duplicate prevention and recovery
completion: Retry succeeds without duplicate effects or lost work

title: Narrow-screen task
evidence: Full task at declared narrow widths with realistic data and on-screen keyboard constraints
completion: The same useful outcome is reachable on narrow screens without inaccessible actions

title: Outcome and next step
evidence: Expected confirmation, resulting record and clear next step after reload
completion: Confirmation matches the actual effect and explains what happens next

title: Back, cancel and resume
evidence: Back/cancel/reopen or refresh interaction with state assertions
completion: Navigation and interruption preserve appropriate work and restore sensible focus/state
